description: This is a PHP source file defining the Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog\Filter class, which represents the model for product filters in the OpenCart admin catalog module. It contains methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving filters and their descriptions.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog\Filter
classes.description: Represents the filter model within the OpenCart admin catalog module, providing CRUD operations for filters and their descriptions.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a new filter with the provided data and returns its ID.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Edits an existing filter identified by filter_id with the provided data.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes the filter specified by filter_id.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific filter by its ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filters based on provided filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Returns the total count of filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a filter in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a filter.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific filter.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter descriptions in a specific language.
